promptIntent.primary: Create only a realistic isolated black-glass cooktop that already matches the target perspective and footprint shown by the hard guide. Preserve the surrounding countertop, cabinet and scene completely; they are reference/protection context only.
appearance: metal grate/burner hardware consistent with the current reference
mechanically plausible burner and knob geometry
geometryConstraints: front edge follows the guide front edge
rear edge follows the guide rear edge
left and right depth edges follow the slanted guide edges
do not make the appliance axis-aligned if the guide is trapezoidal
forbidden: inventing a footprint larger than the hard guide
promptIntent.outputPreference: isolated cooktop with transparent background; no surrounding scene pixels

normalizationPolicy.canvasNormalization: uniform object scaling and translation from generated canvas space into the target crop are allowed as coordinate normalization
rejectIf: object silhouette escapes maximum support after residual budget
object visually floats above the stone
generated background must be retained to make the object look correct
